justifications.research.methodologyDepth: Provides 2-4 years of intensive mentored research with formal coursework in biostatistics, study design, and responsible conduct of research embedded in T32 curricula.
justifications.research.publicationTrack: Funded postdocs publish at substantially higher rates than unfunded postdocs, typically 4-10 first-author papers during the fellowship period.
justifications.research.grantReadiness: F32 application itself is grant-writing training; T32s explicitly prepare trainees for K99/R00, K01, K23, and subsequent R-series awards.
justifications.research.pathwayToIndependence: This is the canonical and most direct pathway to tenure-track PI status in NIH-funded rehabilitation research.
justifications.research.interdisciplinaryFit: T32 programs are typically housed in interdisciplinary centers spanning rehab, neuroscience, engineering, public health, and data science.
justifications.research.efficiency: Requires a prior PhD plus 2-4 additional years at modest postdoc salary (~$56-70K NRSA scale), making it a long and costly pathway despite being funded.
